name: codex-session-logging
description: Capture E3 Codex sessions and cue useful learnings for the Forum Collective review queue.

interface.shortDescription: Capture sessions and cue useful Collective learnings.
interface.longDescription: Codex Session Logging incrementally publishes exact parent and subagent rollout bytes and real cumulative token usage into private Supabase storage and Postgres. It also gives E3 agents bounded guidance to submit useful learnings to the private Forum Collective review queue. Historical transcript backfills are disabled.
defaultPrompt: Capture complete Codex parent and subagent sessions
Drain queued Codex session logs to Supabase
